document.abstract: TRI·COMM PRODUCTIONS, INC. is based on Hilton Head Island, South Carolina. The following discussion highlights TRI·COMM, our capabilities, why we selected the Ampex VPR-1, and how we interface our equipment with our client's needs to provide top quality while still maintaining a respect for the creative, intimate side of television that our production co-workers cherish.

authors.affiliation: Tri-Comm Productions, Inc. Hilton Head Island, South Carolina
authors.bio: Denny K. Fussell is Principal and Chief Engineer of Tri-Comm Productions, Hilton Head Island, South Carolina. Mr. Fussell started his career with the United States Air Force in Technical Counter Measures Development and evaluation of warning systems for use in fighter aircraft and automatic detection and jamming systems for the Air Defense Command. From 1971 to 1973 he was maintenance engineer at WTL V-12 in Jacksonville, Florida, and from 1973 to 1974 he was with the Sea Pines Company as Chief Engineer in the Video Systems Department.
authors.name: Denny K. Fussell
